questions.def: Passive infinitive: 'to be' + past participle after 'expected'.
questions.question: The new policy is expected ___ by the board next week.

questions.def: 'Should have been' + past participle indicates a missed opportunity.
questions.question: The mistake ___ before it caused major problems.

questions.def: Passive requires 'built', not 'building': 'to be built'.
questions.question: The building is believed to be building in the 1920s.

questions.def: 'Should have been' + past participle for passive obligation in the past.
questions.question: The incident ___ to the authorities immediately.

questions.def: 'Alleged' requires passive infinitive 'to have' + past participle.
questions.question: The suspect is alleged ___ the crime.

questions.def: Passive perfect: 'has been' + past participle for completed action.
questions.question: The project ___ by unforeseen circumstances.

questions.def: Simple past passive: 'was' + past participle for a completed past action.
questions.question: The problem ___ only after a thorough investigation.

questions.def: Past simple passive: 'were' + past participle for a past action.
questions.question: The cookies ___ while we were out.

questions.def: 'Is expected to' + verb in base form to express a passive expectation.
questions.question: The new bridge ___ next year.

questions.def: Past simple passive: 'were' + past participle for a past action.
questions.question: We ___ of the changes yesterday.

questions.def: 'Is said to be' + noun phrase. 'To be' as passive infinitive.
questions.question: The artwork is said ___ a masterpiece.

questions.def: Passive phrasal verb: 'was brought' + 'up' to maintain meaning.
questions.question: The issue ___ in the meeting.

questions.def: Past simple passive: 'were' + past participle for a past action.
questions.question: They ___ to the party.

questions.def: 'Going to be' + past participle for a future passive action.
questions.question: The documents are going ___ checked.

questions.def: Future simple passive: 'will be' + past participle for a future action.
questions.question: All applications ___ carefully.

questions.def: Past simple passive: 'was' + past participle for a past action.
questions.question: He ___ for the accident.

questions.def: 'Is being' + past participle for a continuous passive action.
questions.question: The problem ___ being investigated.

questions.def: Future simple passive: 'will be' + past participle for a future action.
questions.question: The truth ___ eventually.

questions.def: Past simple passive: 'was' + past participle for a past action.
questions.question: The thief ___ by the police.

questions.def: 'Should be' + past participle: base form 'be' needed.
questions.question: The email should ___ sent immediately.

questions.def: Future simple passive: 'will be' + past participle for a future action.
questions.question: The results ___ shortly.

questions.def: Past simple passive: 'was' + past participle for a past action.
questions.question: The house ___ by the storm.

questions.def: 'Scheduled to be' + past participle for a planned passive action.
questions.question: The meeting is scheduled ___ held next week.

questions.def: Present perfect passive: 'has been' + past participle for a completed action.
questions.question: The book ___ into several languages.

questions.def: Passive infinitives use 'to be + past participle'.
questions.question: The new policy is expected ___ implemented next month.

questions.def: 'Needed to be + past participle' is used in the passive voice.
questions.question: The documents ___ thoroughly before the meeting.

questions.def: Passive past simple: 'was/were + past participle'.
questions.question: The instructions ___ incorrectly by several team members.

questions.def: Passive third conditional: 'would have been + past participle'.
questions.question: The problem ___ been addressed if we had known.

questions.def: 'It is believed' is a common passive reporting structure.
questions.question: It is ___ that the project will be delayed.

questions.def: Passive voice, past simple: 'was/were + past participle'.
questions.question: I ___ of the changes yesterday.
